lastCompletedStory.title: Add parseContextOccupancy primitive (last-request occupancy, not cumulative)

nextStoryContext: parseContextOccupancy is now exported from src/transcript/usage.ts. It returns input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens of the LAST usage-bearing request in the JSONL (not cumulative). The dedup logic mirrors parseTranscriptUsage (key by message.id|requestId, last-wins). Returns 0 for empty/no-usage transcripts. The next story (US-002 or higher priority) can import this function to build the orchestrator context backstop.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-001 is a pure TypeScript primitive (JSONL line parsing using node:fs/node:path). No external library was introduced or touched.
